strengthening_paths.suggestion: Replace the stopping-time sentence with a defined stopped experiment: specify a stopping time S, the post-S continuation filtration/design, and the corresponding stopped or restarted width and variance functionals; then state the precise optional-stopping corollary.

Prove or state a sharp constant comparison between the explicit stitched band and the lower-bound variance constant on the Halton witness, giving a concrete attainable or quantified near-attainable boundary point beyond the static variance slice.

Develop the continuum OEQ into an explicit finite-grid primal-dual theorem with discretization error, dual-measure support bound, and regret/width guarantee before passing it to a full continuum argument.

recommended_next_step: Revise the undefined stopping-time corollary, then advance the otherwise field-tier, two-axis-novel proposal to Stage 0.
